build_sparse_attention_module: build a SparseMultiheadAttention module with configurable stride and expressivity for sparse transformer attention
compute_checkpoint_index: compute the checkpoint index for a given word index using stride and expressivity parameters
compute_subset_summaries: compute the subset two summaries set for sparse attention pattern across all stride windows
compute_fixed_attention_subset: compute the fixed attention subset for a word index combining stride window and summary tokens
apply_sparse_mask: apply a sparse attention mask to attention weights tensor for efficient long sequence generation
